resolution.plan: Use the instruction and the three citation-format examples of Table 7 as the fixed template. Fill 'Question:' with each of the 948 ASQA dev queries and 'Documents [k] (Title: ...)' for k=1..5 with the top-5 GTR-retrieved Wikipedia passages from ALCE's public ASQA evaluation file. Call gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0.5 (Appendix). Score exact-match recall (ALCE str_em: share of gold short answers appearing in the response) against ALCE's ASQA annotations and compare with 47.0 (Table 1, GPT-4 5-psg, Correct.).
resolution.approximation: Table 7 elides the documents after [3] with '...', so the same document line format is assumed for all five passages; ALCE's str_em is re-implemented from its public definition; sampling at temperature 0.5 adds seed variance.
